青竜: blue dragon (an auspicious creature in Chinese mythology)
扱い: handling (of a machine, tool, etc.); operation; use
狂い: irregularity; deviation; being out of order
才覚: ready wit; quick wits; resourcefulness; talent
通ずる: to be conveyed (of an intention, meaning, etc.); to be understood (by); to be comprehended; to get across (e.g. of an idea)
鋭い: keen (intuition, sense of smell, etc.); acute; sharp (eye, mind, etc.); astute
取り扱う: to deal in; to carry; to sell
収まる: to be settled (dispute, conflict, etc.); to be sorted; to subside (e.g. wind); to calm down

__flags__.彼此: かれこれ here is the adverb 'for around/nearly (several decades)', not 'this and that'
__flags__.八百屋: おやおや is an interjection 'oh my', not greengrocer
__flags__.藪: やぶから棒に = 'out of the blue' idiom; not thicket/quack
__flags__.収まる: 気が収まらない = 'can't be satisfied/calmed down' idiom
__flags__.取り扱う: inflected 取扱い as 'handle/deal in' (merchant context)
